verdict.rationale: Fireworks has a first-party structured-outputs guide. It states that responses conform to your specified format so they are easy to parse, and that output can be forced to conform to a JSON schema. This covers the core of the story. missing for 10: no evidence of grammar-based (e.g. GBNF) constrained decoding, no detail on supported schema features or model coverage, and no independent or hands-on corroboration that outputs reliably parse.
